task.title: Prepare lineage edge benchmark corpus for capital and runtime objects
task.summary_zh: 平行支援 LIN-001，先整理 capital、deployment、runtime、telemetry 相關 edge 候選、查詢基準資料集與 benchmark 量測框架，讓 TEL-001 落地後能直接接 lineage 聚合。
task.phase: Phase 3: Telemetry, Lineage, and Incident Backbone
acceptance: candidate lineage edges across capital deployment runtime and telemetry are enumerated
benchmark corpus shape and p95 measurement method are documented
LIN-001 can consume the prep package without redefining read-model scope
task.next: Review approved by Qwen and finalized. LIN_001A_PREP_PACKET.md, lin001a_benchmark_corpus.json, and benchmark_harness.py are complete under services/registry/lineage/; 13 semantic edges, 22-record corpus across 5 object families, and 5 benchmark cases remain LIN-001-ready. Revalidated with python3 -m py_compile services/registry/lineage/benchmark_harness.py and python3 services/registry/lineage/benchmark_harness.py --corpus services/registry/lineage/lin001a_benchmark_corpus.json --iterations 20 --warmup 3 --enforce-budgets. Review: services/registry/lineage/review_lin001a_qwen_approved.md.

handoffs.message: LIN-001A prep package is ready for review under services/registry/lineage/: LIN_001A_PREP_PACKET.md fixes the semantic edge inventory and naming-alias boundary for capital/deployment/runtime/telemetry; lin001a_benchmark_corpus.json provides the machine-readable fixture and query suite; benchmark_harness.py runs repeatable p95 measurements for runtime_binding_projection, capital_pool_projection, telemetry_event_trace, and forensic_plan_trace. Validation passed: python3 -m py_compile services/registry/lineage/benchmark_harness.py and python3 services/registry/lineage/benchmark_harness.py --corpus services/registry/lineage/lin001a_benchmark_corpus.json --iterations 20 --warmup 3 --enforce-budgets.

Review approved. All 3 acceptance criteria met: 13 semantic edges enumerated across capital/deployment/runtime/telemetry; benchmark corpus (22 records, 5 object families) with FK integrity verified; p95 harness validates all 5 cases within SLA budgets; naming-drift alias table covers both physical field drifts; scope boundary is deliberate and LIN-001-ready. Review at services/registry/lineage/review_lin001a_qwen_approved.md.
